title: Leveraging Unlabeled Data to Predict Out-of-Distribution Performance (ATC)
one_line_what_it_does: Shows target accuracy is not identified from labeled source + unlabeled target alone; Corollary 1 impossibility absent shift assumptions; proposes thresholded-confidence estimator.

title: Estimating and Explaining Model Performance When Both Covariates and Labels Shift (SEES/SJS)
one_line_what_it_does: Sparse Joint Shift model: marginal feature law identifies joint law when non-shifted features are weakly correlated; label-free performance estimation.
bears_on_which_part: A: identifiability class for label-free risk; hidden offsets independent of X are outside SJS

title: Estimating Model Performance Under Covariate Shift Without Labels (PAPE)
